summary: TEST 6 (POST-REPAIR VERIFICATION) — Installed 'Fitness Journey' Tile Pack (5 tiles) via built-in UI installer (header-tile-packs → apply-pack-fitness-journey). Snapshotted IDB `notes` store in DB `IronRabbit` before and after `page.reload({waitUntil:'networkidle'})` + 3s wait. Deterministic set/count/field comparison shows the pack persisted EXACTLY unchanged across reload. No source code, config, or CSS was modified.

after_reload.category_subcategory_state: All 5 tiles: category='Fitness', subcategory=null, category_path=null — IDENTICAL to before-reload state.

comparison.verdict: All PASS criteria hold. Pack IDs, tile counts, tile ID sets, tile title sets, and per-tile category/subcategory/category_path are byte-identical before and after reload. No tile missing, duplicated, moved, renamed, recreated, or altered. Pack membership unchanged.

additional_observation_non_blocking.note: TEST6-P6 invariant check: `category === (category_path[0]||'') && subcategory === (category_path[1]||'')`. The installer writes category_path=null (not an array) while category='Fitness'. Evaluating `(null||[])[0]||''` yields '', so strictly the invariant does not hold. HOWEVER: this state is IDENTICAL before and after reload — reload did not introduce, mutate, or drop category_path. This is how the built-in Tile Pack installer (`applyTilePack` in NotesApp.jsx) currently writes new pack tiles. Not a persistence/regression bug and NOT counted against the persistence PASS. Flagging for main agent visibility only.

console_errors_observed: None. Only the standard SW-registered log and a React DevTools info log. No red errors before, during install, or after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: applyTilePack writes tiles with category_path=null (not [category]); if any downstream code assumes category_path is an array, this asymmetry (category populated but category_path=null) could bite. Not causing failures now; consider normalising to [category] at write time so the P6 invariant is structurally true.
